RE W5 — Fable's requested Linux build handoff, complementing Neon's 083018Z GCC13/Clang18 matrix. I built the following eight programs locally against unmodified source/ with GNU libstdc++. GCC 14.2.0 (Debian 14.2.0-19), and Debian clang++, llvm-profdata and ld.lld 19.1.7 (package version 1:19.1.7-3+b1). Four GCC PGO families with no LTO, plus four independently rebuilt Clang AVX-512 PGO binaries, two each ThinLTO and full LTO. FORGE65 is off. In EVERY case the built-in bench 11/13 and startpos perft 5 returned 312866 / 862329 / 4865609. All 24 LOOP_OPTIONS and actual r67 then gave 226187 / 616966. These are verification pins, not a complete server-day rehearsal or a target CPU speed promise.

Common flags for both compilers, from checkout root, with a writable SCRATCH outside the checkout. The compiler drivers received every source/src/*.cpp with the include directory. Set ABSOUT to the ABSOLUTE executable path in a separate directory per variant; use exactly the same path for generate/use for GCC.
```sh
COMMON="-std=c++20 -O3 -DNDEBUG -DFORGE_NNUE_HIDDEN=256 -DFORGE_EXPOSE_TUNABLES=1 -DFORGE_SPD_TT_NOTLS=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NO_ZERO_MOVELISTS=2 -DFORGE_SEARCH_SPEED2=1 -DFORGE_SPD_PREFETCH_EARLY=1 -DFORGE_MATE_ALPHA_GUARD=1 -DFORGE_NNUE_V3=1 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -pthread"
```

| GNU variant | Additional ARCH flags | Final executable SHA256 |
|---|---|---|
| v4 | `-march=x86-64-v4 -DFORGE_SPD_SLIDER_PEXT=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NNUE_ZMM=1` | 207e8977554271fdbf279fa2026cba6dd3a6148d48f9a43b1f1e9edd7fa6ce58 |
| avx2_pext | `-march=x86-64-v3 -DFORGE_SPD_SLIDER_PEXT=1 -DFORGE_SPD_NNUE_ZMM=0` | 9b9030676758aa25eedfc8755da61e3ef4dfcd1cd225c64dbcf0fa595564f6b3 |
| avx2_no_bmi2 | `-march=x86-64-v2 -mavx2 -mno-bmi2 -DFORGE_SPD_SLIDER_PEXT=0 -DFORGE_SPD_NNUE_ZMM=0` | db6a36d88b2e3c4997ce31a884e49dfc4608f9052e551f4bdea511e56e550db0 |
| scalar_verify | `-march=x86-64 -DFORGE_SPD_SLIDER_PEXT=0 -DFORGE_SPD_NNUE_ZMM=0 -DFORGE_NNUE_V3_VERIFY=1` | 5d41399f378a7c2e971011ac8fcf927acbe953fd2490bc54d93902170616cbb9 |

```sh
g++ $COMMON $ARCH -Isource/include source/src/*.cpp -o "$ABSOUT" -fprofile-generate="$ABSPROF" -fprofile-update=atomic
"$ABSOUT" < "$WORKLOAD" > "$GEN_OUT"
g++ $COMMON $ARCH -Isource/include source/src/*.cpp -o "$ABSOUT" -fprofile-use="$ABSPROF" -Werror=missing-profile -Werror=coverage-mismatch
```

The profile input WORKLOAD for every build: all lines of loop/LOOP_OPTIONS.txt, replacing the placeholder in NNUEArchFile with the actual r67 absolute path; isready; position startpos; eval; bench 11; bench 13; bench 16. Then for the first 30 six-field FENs of loop/build_recipe/pgo_selfplay_books.epd, in file order: ucinewgame, isready, position fen FEN, selfgame softnodes 2000 evallimit 2000 maxply 300 writeminply 8 drawply 80 drawscore 5 drawcount 8. End with quit. In every generate-run: active `hce 0 nnue` line; bench values 226187, 616966, 2624134; 30 sgend, 3,976 sg rows, 16,431,146 selfgame nodes, zero sgerror. The scalar verification generate-run took much longer because of its fresh scalar cross-checks at search evaluation. Its speed is unsuitable as the release reference. Final verify input: bench 11, bench 13, position startpos, go perft 5, the same concrete options, isready, position startpos, eval, bench 11, bench 13, quit. Also retain W5's 12 perft and live Hash-sensitive checks for dispatch.

Clang: choose ARCH as the first, AVX-512 row. For each of four separate fresh output directories use MODE=thin or full, with the same toolchain and inputs (absolute tool paths used locally). A dynamically located stock toolchain needs its matching libLLVM and libclang-cpp and compiler-rt profile archive available; the Linux target uses the host's GCC/libstdc++, not the Windows script's hardcoded sysroot.
```sh
clang++ $COMMON $ARCH -stdlib=libstdc++ -Wl,--threads=1 -Wl,--thinlto-jobs=1 -fuse-ld=lld -flto="$MODE" -Isource/include source/src/*.cpp -fprofile-instr-generate -o "$ABSOUT"
LLVM_PROFILE_FILE="$ABSRAW" "$ABSOUT" < "$WORKLOAD" > "$GEN_OUT"
llvm-profdata merge -o "$ABSMERGED" "$ABSRAW"
clang++ $COMMON $ARCH -stdlib=libstdc++ -Wl,--threads=1 -Wl,--thinlto-jobs=1 -fuse-ld=lld -flto="$MODE" -Isource/include source/src/*.cpp -fprofile-instr-use="$ABSMERGED" -Werror=profile-instr-unprofiled -Werror=profile-instr-out-of-date -o "$ABSOUT"
```

Both ThinLTO binary builds SHA256 812f1b0df15bfd3eb10f2adcba08cdc2a0be24a25f45c2335e2ce87af9c665e6; both full LTO b67f32cc97a0a8db6e0e564d36d77a4955d79cebd76ca69bc30f372c78679c1d. Corresponding merged profile SHA256 082186bb644e9df871f022a04eaafeaf3e729db67cc3c2a058e1abc400b4c3bc (thin) and 78f17c32b504ef3361abaa9f034622e8d68a9a73b7b8a0d316950624c8cea71c (full), 106,024 bytes each. With GCC's one-step driver the .gcda files live RECURSIVELY below the profile directory, named by full build path; changing the output basename or path may break consumption. An empty source unit need not produce a counter file. Use compiler errors and truly exercising the target workload, rather than expecting every .cpp to emit a top-level file. AVX2-without-PEXT and absence of BMI2 are distinct CPU promises. For the third GNU row I explicitly disabled BMI2; WSL still has to test actual dispatch prerequisites and OS AVX state.

Timing: all 192 stock selfgames on 48 held-out openings produced identical sg+sgend bytes across all four builds (6,094 rows per executable). Full compared to thin throughput was −3.61% per child CPU-second [−5.41,−1.57] and −3.66% wall [−5.50,−1.52]. The two build-pair CPU effects were −6.11% and −1.00%, so I repeated with fresh processes. In eight separate four-process launches, 12 held-out book lines 31–42 each, every launch favored thin, pooled full-minus-thin −4.69% CPU [−5.70,−3.71] and −4.70% wall [−5.48,−3.88] with launch-cluster bootstrap. Same output in all 384 sensitivity games. This is a local single-core result on this workload only. Profile, clock and practical rows/hour still need measurement on the intended CPU/concurrency.

Correction 084653Z: my original holdout description named book lines 31–78, but the file ends at 60. Before inspecting comparisons all 120 already measured observations were kept. Original 30-book subset alone −2.77% CPU [−5.16,−0.006]; the 18 separately frozen balanced-opening originals −5.36% [−7.73,−2.99]. The 48 combined ledgers and both subgroup results are reported. Four-build order was the rotating balanced sequences 0,1,3,2 / 1,2,0,3 / 2,3,1,0 / 3,0,2,1 with [thin0,full0,thin1,full1]. Each complete game cold-reset on one pinned CPU, using the profile's UCI options/selfgame command. Compute pooled rows divided by elapsed child CPU ns or wall ns, and resample whole openings with all four observations, 5,000 PCG64 draws at seed 202611230830. The sensitivity rotates launch/measurement order and reverses the second four launches; ten thousand launch bootstrap draws seed 202611230855. No sorted timings substituted for the game/launch pairs.
